Hi Anna / Gabe — thanks for the patience. Attached are the artifacts requested for OrionBio's procurement packet:

- SIG-completed.xlsx (completed workbook; redlines in sheet "answers_reviewed")
- privatelink-topology.pdf (single-page diagram annotated with VPC endpoints, egress guardrails, and failover path)
- kms-segmentation.csv (column headers: key_id,key_owner,region,rotation_policy,hsm_backed)
- jurisdictional_hosting_letter.pdf (signed template confirming EU-region processing and default non-prod handling)

Summary (short): Redwood Inference processes and stores Orion-region workloads exclusively in EU regions when the "EU-only" option is selected. Non-production environments are deployed in the same EU tenancy by default; cross-region replication and backups to non-EU locations are opt-in and require a documented provisioning request and change control. PrivateLink connections terminate at customer-specific VPC endpoints in the EU region; egress to other regions is blocked by default unless explicitly authorized. KMS keys can be either customer-managed (CMK) or Redwood-managed; the attached CSV shows the partitioning we use and indicates which keys are HSM-backed.

Next steps: please confirm receipt and whether procurement wants the files uploaded to your drive folder or shared via a secure transfer link. If you want a quick walkthrough, we can schedule a 30-min call tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Security & Compliance Program Manager
